edits.before: Finally, compatibility over all coefficient embeddings is used before descent from \(\overline\mathbb Q\) to \(\mathbb Q\). For a finite field of definition, invariance under the decomposition groups for almost all rational primes forces invariance under the entire finite Galois group by Chebotarev. This proves rationality in the quotient, not rational conjugacy in \(G^\mathrm{ad}\). Corollary 3.12 then follows because an \(F\)-rational point determines a Galois-stable geometric component, whose field of definition is contained in \(F\).
